description_en: Moves an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance to a resource group
description_zh: 将AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例移动到指定资源组
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-resource-group --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --new-resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃。实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the instance. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 目标资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
